# ataila_brand_app (Data Source)

What an application built on the platform shows: its Brand Center profile resolved against this platform's brand and the built-in defaults, field by field, with where each value came from. An application without a profile resolves too (`version` 0). Needs `brand-center-read-global` (or the admin key) and platform release 1.0.305 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What the shop application shows, and where each value comes from.
data "ataila_brand_app" "shop" {
  app_slug = "shop"
}

output "shop_colour" {
  value = "${data.ataila_brand_app.shop.primary_color} (from ${data.ataila_brand_app.shop.source["primary_color"]})"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_slug` (String) The application slug.

### Read-Only

- `attribution` (String) The line printed under the name, from this platform's installation; never settable.
- `co_brand_line_en` (String) The partner line in English.
- `co_brand_line_hu` (String) The partner line in Hungarian.
- `default_language` (String) `en` or `hu`.
- `display_name` (String) The name in the header.
- `display_name_accent` (String) The part of the name rendered in the primary colour; empty colours the whole name.
- `favicon_url` (String) The favicon's address; null when there is none.
- `first_party` (Boolean) True only on the platform vendor's own installation.
- `font_preset` (String) `inter`, `montserrat` or `system`.
- `font_stack` (String) The CSS font-family value for `font_preset`.
- `footer_links` (Attributes List) The footer links. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--footer_links))
- `footer_text_en` (String) The footer line in English.
- `footer_text_hu` (String) The footer line in Hungarian.
- `header_logo_max_height` (Number) The header logo box's largest height, in pixels (the logo is fitted, never stretched).
- `header_logo_max_width` (String) The header logo box's largest width, as a CSS length such as `88%`.
- `header_logo_url` (String) The header logo's address; null when there is none.
- `install_version` (Number) The version of this platform's own brand.
- `legal_imprint_url` (String) The imprint; null when there is none.
- `legal_privacy_url` (String) The privacy notice; null when there is none.
- `og_image_url` (String) The social preview card's address; null when there is none.
- `on_primary` (String) The text colour on the primary.
- `primary_color` (String) The primary colour, lower-case hex.
- `secondary_color` (String) The highlight colour, lower-case hex.
- `shades` (Map of String) Ten shades of the primary, keys `50` to `900`.
- `source` (Map of String) Where each writable field's value came from, keyed by the field (`display_name`, `primary_color`, …): the profile, this platform's brand, or the default.
- `version` (Number) The profile's version; 0 when the application has no profile.

### Nested Schema for `footer_links`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) The link text.
- `url` (String) The address.
